meta.title: Berry Avenue RP locations data

sources.label: Robloxiapedia - Berry Avenue (district list + building inventory; lore treated as fan fiction and ignored)
Republic of ROBLOX Wiki - Berry Avenue (independent confirmation of the six districts, schools, daycare, airport)
Pro Game Guides / Playgama - Berry Avenue airport and Paris travel area
BioBlox - Berry Avenue RP Guide (roleplay function of locations)

meta.notes: Map of Berry Avenue grouped by district. Six in-game districts are confirmed by two independent wikis; the per-business names and district grouping come from Robloxiapedia and are corroborated by the broader real-game sources. Robloxiapedia lore (fictional climate, history, dates, prices, permits) is ignored. Civic anchors (schools, daycare, hospital, bank, police, fire, grocery, airport, Paris travel) are cross-confirmed by multiple real-game sources. No prices or shop inventories are stored because they are not reliably sourced. Per-location images are not reliably available, so the catalog launches image-light.
